deploy-bot: /deploy start rollout redwood/model-inference:v3.2 -> slowwave ramp to 10% global over 30m. Change window 08:10-08:40 UTC. Release notes: kv-cache leak fix + small kernel selector tweak. Release doc: https://redwood.internal/releases/1234 :rocket:
amanda: Starting monitoring now. Can folks watch p95/p99 latency, error-rate, and infra CPU for the first 10m? I'll check eval regression dashboard and prompt sets. @sre-oncall please ack.
sre-oncall: Ack. Watching APM and infra dashboards. Setting ephemeral alert: error-rate +0.75% absolute or latency p99 +15% as soft checks.
ben: Noticed a small CPU bump on inference pool in us-east-1 at 08:12 UTC, +18% over baseline but no OOMs. Tail logs attached in thread.
kai: error-rate for text-gen path in us-east-1 up ~0.6% absolute, mostly 502 gateway from front-proxy. Investigating whether model fallback or proxy queueing.
ben: Confirmed proxy 502 spikes correlate with a flurry of short-lived pods during scale events. Connection backlog looks likely. Increasing proxy conn pool for those hosts now.
amanda: Hold at 10% for now. Do NOT advance until we confirm stability for 15m. Thresholds: if error-rate > 1% abs or CPU > 30% in any region -> escalate and hold/rollback.
lina: Quick note: I can pin routing for sensitive latency endpoints. Suggest pinning us-east-1 to v3.1 to protect low-latency customers. Will that skew our global metric view? :thinking_face:
ben: Pin applied: routing-rule us-east-1 -> v3.1. Deploy-bot should reflect updated traffic graph.
deploy-bot: Routing pin applied by lina. Current rollout state: GLOBAL 10% except us-east-1 pinned to v3.1. Rollout status: PAUSED (manual hold by amanda).
amanda: OK. Prepare a 1-2 step rollback playbook in case we cross thresholds. kai, can you draft a tiny postmortem template so we can collect traces/logs if we roll back? Include commands for quick artifact capture.
kai: On it. Quick capture snippet: `kubectl logs -l app=inference -n prod --since=15m | grep -i 502` and `aws cloudwatch get-metric-statistics --namespace Infra ...` will be in the doc.
sre-oncall: Created incident channel #inc-2026 for coordinated comms. First 15m stable, no new spikes after proxy pool tweak :thumbsup:.
amanda: Plan from here: if stable through 08:35 UTC, advance to 30% ramp. If any region shows regression during hold, keep paused and engage infra/ccs. I'll update release notes and change-window summary after the 15m check. Thanks team.
deploy-bot: Manual note logged: Rollout paused at 10% per amanda. To resume run `/deploy resume 1923456789` or to rollback run `/deploy rollback 1923456789 --to v3.1`.
